senses.gloss: (cmp. לוּשׁ a. Arab. latta) to stir, mix, esp. to stir the grain in water for the purpose of moistening it before grinding, in gen. to wash or moisten grain.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:9">Tosef. B. Kam. X, 9</cite> <he>ולא לְתָתָן</he> and the miller omitted to moisten it.
<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:2">Tosef. Makhsh. III, 2</cite> <he>ללוֹתְתָן בטל וכ׳</he> to have them washed in the dew or rain.
<cite ref="Pesachim 36a:14">Pes. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>אין לוֹתְתִין וכ׳</he> must not be washed before grinding; a. fr.
